fields.description: Rosso Bay Residences is Aldar’s beachfront residential development on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Its resort-inspired setting combines apartments and larger residences with beachside lounges, leisure facilities and spaces for residents to work and gather.

sources.label: Aldar: combined Nikki Beach / Rosso Bay presentation, Rosso pages 35–49
Property Finder: Rosso Bay project terms
Bayut: Rosso Bay Residences building guide

overview: Rosso Bay’s shared spaces combine beachside recreation with quieter places to read, work and relax. A beach clubhouse and lounge sit alongside pools, play spaces and fitness facilities. Buyers should distinguish residential facilities from optional hospitality services when reviewing ongoing charges.
research.locationNote: The development is on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Bayut identifies Sheikh Mohammed Bin Salem Road (E11) as the wider connection. Check the exact building approach and beach access for the selected home.
research.priceNote: The developer presentation starts one-bedroom homes at AED 1.76m. The undated figure requires a fresh quotation.
research.paymentNote: The brochure’s overall split is corroborated by Property Finder and Bayut, which report 10% booking, 50% construction instalments and 40% at handover. Unit-specific transfer balances can differ.
research.handoverNote: The brochure gives 2028; both portals report Q4 2028. Obtain written confirmation for the selected unit.
